plan_review.notes: Independent plan review confirmed the reserve-threading design. It identified a direct returning-to-abandoned unit-test gap; resolved by asserting the intent first returns without the reserve and then abandons when the reserve is supplied.

independent_grade.notes: The implementation successfully resolves the intent/execution mismatch by threading the merchant weapon reserve into updateSpellBrokerIntent and applying it exclusively to repeat purchases. The diff is surgically scoped, aligns precisely with the execution logic in auto-progression.ts, and is comprehensively verified by both new unit tests and the targeted headless regression sweep test. Complete documentation, apple metrics, and review ledgers are provided in accordance with repository policy.
